base_maps.description: Select tile layers to use as base layers in map outputs. The first layer in the list will be the bottommost layer displayed.

patrol_types.title: Patrol Types
patrol_types.description: Specify the patrol type(s) to analyze (optional). Leave empty to analyze all patrol types.

status.title: Patrol Status
status.description: Choose to analyze patrols with a certain status. If left empty, patrols of all status will be analyzed

patrols_overlap_daterange.title: Patrols Overlap Daterange
patrols_overlap_daterange.description: Whether or not to include patrols that start or end outside of the time range

bounding_box.title: Bounding Box
bounding_box.description: Filter events to inside these bounding coordinates.

filter_point_coords.title: Filter Exact Point Coordinates
filter_point_coords.description: By adding a filter, the workflow will not include events recorded at the specified coordinates.

trajectory_segment_filter.description: Filter track data by setting limits on track segment length, duration, and speed. Segments outside these bounds are removed, reducing noise and to focus on meaningful movement patterns.

Spatial Features.description: Optionally overlay any EarthRanger spatial feature layer on the patrol map.

group_by.title: Group By
group_by.description: Column used to group features in the map legend e.g. 'Feature Type' shows one legend entry per feature type.

legend_title.title: Legend Title
legend_title.description: Label shown in the map legend e.g. 'Park Boundary'.

Local Spatial Features.description: Optionally overlay a locally-uploaded spatial file on the patrol map.

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: Layer name within a GeoPackage file. Only required when the file contains multiple layers.

group_by.title: Group By
group_by.description: Column used to group features in the map legend e.g. 'name', 'category'.

legend_title.title: Legend Title
legend_title.description: Label shown in the map legend e.g. 'Park Boundary'.

style.title: Style
style.description: Optional: Customise how features are rendered on the map.

Map Viewport.description: Controls how tightly every map zooms and frames its data. Applies to all maps at once. Only adjust if maps consistently look too zoomed in or out.

settings.title: Map Viewport
settings.description: Controls how tightly every map zooms and frames its data. Applies to all maps at once. Only adjust if maps consistently look too zoomed in or out.

Patrol Style.description: Choose how patrol tracks are colored on the map.

input_column_name.title: Groupby
input_column_name.description: Color patrol tracks by the selected attribute. Each unique value is assigned a distinct color on the map.

colormap.title: Palette
colormap.description: Choose a color palette. For low-cardinality data (e.g. patrol type) any palette works; for high-cardinality data (e.g. IDs) use tab20, tab20b, or tab20c to reduce color repetition.

custom_colors.title: Custom Colors
custom_colors.description: Leave empty to use the palette above. When provided, these colors are applied instead.

auto_highlight.title: Auto Highlight
auto_highlight.description: Enable automatic highlighting when hovering over a patrol track.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Transparency of the patrol tracks, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (fully opaque).

pickable.title: Pickable
pickable.description: Allow patrol tracks to be interactive (hoverable and clickable).

get_path.title: Path
get_path.description: Column or expression used to determine the path coordinates.

get_color.title: Color
get_color.description: Column used for track color. Defaults to the colormap output.

get_width.title: Line Width
get_width.description: Width of the patrol track line.

width_scale.title: Width Scale
width_scale.description: Global multiplier applied to all track widths.

width_min_pixels.title: Width Min Pixels
width_min_pixels.description: Minimum track width in pixels regardless of zoom level.

width_max_pixels.title: Width Max Pixels
width_max_pixels.description: Maximum track width in pixels regardless of zoom level.

width_units.title: Width Units
width_units.description: Units for the track width — pixels (screen-space) or meters (world-space).

cap_rounded.title: Rounded Caps
cap_rounded.description: Draw rounded ends on each track segment.

joint_rounded.title: Joint Rounded
joint_rounded.description: Draw rounded joins between path segments.

billboard.title: Billboard
billboard.description: Render the path always facing the camera regardless of map tilt.

tooltip_columns.title: Tooltip Columns
tooltip_columns.description: Restrict the on-hover tooltip to these column names. None (default) shows all properties.

input_column_name.title: Groupby
input_column_name.description: Color events by the selected attribute. Each unique value is assigned a distinct color on the map.

colormap.title: Palette
colormap.description: Choose a color palette. For low-cardinality data (e.g. event type) any palette works; for high-cardinality data (e.g. IDs) use tab20, tab20b, or tab20c to reduce color repetition.

custom_colors.title: Custom Colors
custom_colors.description: Leave empty to use the palette above. When provided, these colors are applied instead.

auto_highlight.title: Auto Highlight
auto_highlight.description: Enable automatic highlighting when hovering over a marker.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Transparency of the markers, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (fully opaque).

pickable.title: Pickable
pickable.description: Allow markers to be interactive (hoverable and clickable).

get_position.title: Position
get_position.description: Column or expression used to determine the marker position on the map.

get_fill_color.title: Fill Color
get_fill_color.description: Column used for marker fill color. Defaults to the colormap output.

get_line_color.title: Outline Color
get_line_color.description: Column used for marker outline color. Defaults to the colormap output.

get_line_width.title: Outline Width
get_line_width.description: Width of the marker outline when Stroked is enabled.

get_elevation.title: Elevation
get_elevation.description: Height of each marker for 3D visualisation.

radius_units.title: Radius Units
radius_units.description: Units for the marker radius — pixels (screen-space) or meters (world-space).

radius_scale.title: Radius Scale
radius_scale.description: Global multiplier applied to all marker radii.

radius_min_pixels.title: Radius Min Pixels
radius_min_pixels.description: Minimum radius size in pixels regardless of zoom level.

radius_max_pixels.title: Radius Max Pixels
radius_max_pixels.description: Maximum radius size in pixels regardless of zoom level.

line_width_units.title: Line Width Units
line_width_units.description: Units for the outline width — pixels (screen-space) or meters (world-space).

line_width_scale.title: Line Width Scale
line_width_scale.description: Global multiplier applied to all outline widths.

line_width_min_pixels.title: Line Width Min Pixels
line_width_min_pixels.description: Minimum outline width in pixels regardless of zoom level.

line_width_max_pixels.title: Line Width Max Pixels
line_width_max_pixels.description: Maximum outline width in pixels regardless of zoom level.

stroked.title: Stroked
stroked.description: Draw a border outline around each marker.

filled.title: Filled
filled.description: Fill the interior of each marker with color.

elevation_scale.title: Elevation Scale
elevation_scale.description: Global multiplier applied to the elevation value for 3D visualisation.

billboard.title: Billboard
billboard.description: Always face the marker toward the camera regardless of map tilt.

tooltip_columns.title: Tooltip Columns
tooltip_columns.description: Restrict the on-hover tooltip to these column names. None (default) shows all properties.

attachments_subdir.title: Attachments Subdirectory
attachments_subdir.description: Subdirectory inside the output directory to store attachments.

skip_download.title: Skip Photo Attachments
skip_download.description: If True, skip downloading event photos, and the report will not include any images.

var.title: Template Path
var.description: Path or URL to the .docx Jinja2 template used for the patrol report.

color.description: Fill hex colour(s). For SVG icons this tints the marker. Cycles across rows.
color.title: Color

size.description: Point radius / icon size in pixels. Leave empty to use the size set in EarthRanger.
size.title: Size

fill_color.description: Fill hex colour(s) e.g. ['#FFA500']. Cycles across rows.
fill_color.title: Fill Color

width_px.description: Actual rendered map width in pixels — a dashboard tile, not the full browser window. Our map widgets use half the 10-column dashboard grid (layout.json), which measures ~450-870px wide in practice; 650 is the middle of that range.
width_px.title: Map Width (px)

height_px.description: Actual rendered map height in pixels.
height_px.title: Map Height (px)

padding_fraction.description: Fraction of the viewport left as empty margin around the data on each side.
padding_fraction.title: Padding Around Data

outlier_trim_percent.description: Percentile trimmed from each end of the coordinate range before framing (e.g. 1 uses the 1st-99th percentile). Makes framing robust to a small number of extreme outliers, such as a bad GPS fix, without needing to filter them out of the data itself. Keep this low, since a real patrol trajectory's own extremities can span a wide percentile range, so a high value crops legitimate track data out of the frame.
outlier_trim_percent.title: Outlier Trim (%)
